scope: Read-only classification of LON/HCC/DHWC nvi setpoint objects and KM-BUS participant identity blocks on the local VDensHO1/20C2 WB2A.
conclusions: A401/A403/A441/A443 all read exactly 20.00 C. The Viessmann LON handbook independently documents 20 C as the fallback for HCC nvi room/flow setpoint variables, strongly resolving these readings as default/inactive network-input values rather than local controller outputs.
A401 is not a mirror of either local room target tested: 0x2306 was 21 C and explicit external-room target 0x2321 was 0 C while A401 stayed 20.00 C.
A403 is not a mirror of the active internal A1 flow target: 0x2544 was 0.0 C while A403 was 20.00 C.
A3C0 is not a mirror of either tested local DHW target representation: configured user target 0x6300 was 45 C, current/effective target 0x6500 was 5.0 C, while A3C0 remained 50.00 C.

Viessmann LON documentation states that nviDHWCSetpt is only functional when the DHWC ApplicMode explicitly selects the external LON DHW setpoint path; therefore the raw 50.00 C value must not be presented as an active local DHW target without the ApplicMode.
The internal pump is the only populated pump software-index block among the sampled pump identities: 0x0A54 is nonzero while 0x0A4C and 0x0A50 are all zero.

HCC_nvi_default.statement: A401/A403/A441/A443 are LON input-side values; the observed 20.00 C is the documented HCC fallback/default and is not the live local A1/M2 setpoint.
HCC_nvi_default.basis: All four local reads are 20.00 C including absent M2, and Viessmann LON handbook documents 20 C as the fallback for nviHCCxSpaceSet and nviHCCxFlowTSet.

DHWC_nvi_mapping.statement: A3C0 is not a direct mirror of either configured 0x6300 or current/effective 0x6500 on this appliance.
DHWC_nvi_mapping.basis: A3C0=50.00 C, 0x6300=45 C, 0x6500=5.0 C in the same observation period; vendor LON documentation makes nviDHWCSetpt conditional on ApplicMode.

HCC_external_room_mapping.statement: A401 is not a direct mirror of 0x2321.

next_read_only: Interpret 0x00 and 0xFF conservatively as internal/default/non-overriding states because catalog/manual naming differs, while both leave the related nvi setpoint non-authoritative.

hcc.nviHCCxSpaceSet: SNVT_temp_p; only functional for HCC ApplicMode modes that explicitly use it; when no receive-heartbeat message is present its documented fallback is 20 C.
hcc.nviHCCxFlowTSet: SNVT_temp_p; only functional for HVAC_FLOW_TEMP; documented fallback is 20 C if that mode remains selected without a fresh value.
hcc.default_internal_control: In the default/internal HCC operating modes, the nvi space/flow setpoints are not functional.

dhwc.nviDHWCSetpt: SNVT_temp_p; used only when nviDHWCApplicMd selects HVAC_HEAT.
dhwc.default_internal_control: For HVAC_AUTO/HVAC_NUL-style internal control, the nviDHWC setpoint is not functional and internal DHW control applies.
